# Style and tone

- Plain, concise language. Match response shape to the task — no headers/sections for a one-line answer.
- Don't assume a task is finished. Validate by running the code, running the tests, or reading the result.
- When ending a turn, one or two sentences summarising what changed and what's next. No recap lists.
